tutorial.pigbuilder.title: Side-Scroll Smasher
tutorial.pigbuilder.step0: Welcome! You got a starter kit: an Assembler plus Frame, Wheel and Propeller blocks. Type /sidescroll help any time.
tutorial.pigbuilder.step1: Press %s to switch to 2.5D side view. A/D move, Space jumps. Press it again to go back to normal.
tutorial.pigbuilder.step2: In side view, left-click smashes the block in front of you. Hold W and click to smash above, S and click to smash below. Sand and gravel get pushed instead.
tutorial.pigbuilder.step3: Build a vehicle from Frame, Wheel and Propeller blocks (planks, logs, wool and glass count too). Wheels give drive, propellers give lift.
tutorial.pigbuilder.step4: Right-click any part of it with the Contraption Assembler. The whole connected structure turns into one vehicle.
tutorial.pigbuilder.step5: Right-click the vehicle to ride it. A/D drive, Space fires propellers, Shift gets you off. It bulldozes blocks in its way.
tutorial.pigbuilder.step6: Shift + right-click it with the Assembler to turn it back into blocks. Try /sidescroll start for a ready-made cart. Have fun!
